This Week in Santa Clarita... 🌿 Looking for a way to give back to your community? Join us on Saturday, September 19, at the Newhall Community Center for the 31st Annual River Rally Clean-Up from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. Over the past 30 …years, volunteers have removed more than 510,000 pounds of trash from the Santa Clara River! This year, you can be part of the effort and help keep one of Southern California’s last natural, free-flowing river systems clean. And once the clean-up wraps up, don’t forget to check out the Environmental Expo! Sign up today at GreenSantaClarita.com. #santaclarita #staygreen #community #cleanup #riverrally

We made it a good day on the Beach Bus this past weekend with our third and final Beach Ball Giveaway, but weekend with our third and final Beach Ball Giveaway, bu…summer isn’t over just yet! 🏖️🚌😎 The Beach Bus is hitting the road one final time this Labor Day weekend. ☀️ Catch some waves and let us do the driving! 🌊🚌 Learn more at SantaClaritaTransit.com/Beach-Bus/. - ¡Así se disfruta el verano! ☀️🌊 Este fin de semana vivimos un gran día a bordo del Beach Bus con nuestra tercera y última entrega de pelotas de playa. 🏖️🚌😎 Y aunque las entregas llegaron a su fin, todavía queda una última oportunidad para disfrutar del Beach Bus. 🚌 Este fin de semana de Labor Day, súbete al Beach Bus en su último recorrido de la temporada. Tú disfruta de la playa y las olas; nosotros te llevamos. 🌊☀️ Conoce todos los detalles en SantaClaritaTransit.com/Beach-Bus/. #SantaClaritaTransit #BeachBus #SantaClarita
